sloka: ततस्तां शिंशपां सीता राक्षसीभिः समावृता ।अभिगम्य विशालाक्षी तस्थौ शोकपरिप्लुता ।। ५.२२.१३।।।।
transliteration: tatastāṁ śiṁśapāṁ sītā rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtā ।abhigamya viśālākṣī tasthau śokapariplutā ।। 5.22.13।।।।

translations.english: "Obviously there is no one among your people keen on your welfare since nobody is preventing you from this reproachable act.
